description: Mock auth + Auth UI polish. Wire LoginPage and SignupPage to bypass backend and navigate directly to /business. Polish ForgotPasswordPage, ResetPasswordPage, OtpPage to show success state and auto-navigate to /business after 1.5s. Add 'Demo Mode' badge to all auth forms. Improve auth card aesthetics: larger card max-width (440px), upgraded shadow, better spacing, glass-style header gradient strip on the card, demo badge chip.
steps: 1. In src/features/auth/LoginPage.tsx: Replace the onSubmit body with: setUser({id:'demo-001',businessName:'Demo Business',email:'demo@influnz.in',role:'business'} as any); navigate('/business',{replace:true}); — keep all form validation and the try/catch structure, just replace the authService.login call. Replace the handleGoogle body similarly. Add a 'Demo Mode' badge directly above the <h1> in the form header area using the new .in-demo-badge class. Remove the 'redirectTo' logic (hardcode '/business').

2. In src/features/auth/SignupPage.tsx: Replace onSubmit body with: setUser({id:'demo-001',businessName:'Demo Business',email:'demo@influnz.in',role:'business'} as any); navigate('/business',{replace:true}); — keep the authService import (just don't call it). Replace handleGoogle similarly. Add useAuth import and destructure setUser. Add the .in-demo-badge chip above the form title.

3. In src/features/auth/ForgotPasswordPage.tsx: Replace onSubmit body with: setSent(true); setTimeout(()=>navigate('/business',{replace:true}),1500); — remove authService call but keep import. Add the .in-demo-badge chip near the page title.

4. In src/features/auth/ResetPasswordPage.tsx: Replace onSubmit body with: setDone(true); setTimeout(()=>navigate('/business',{replace:true}),1500); — remove authService call but keep import. Add .in-demo-badge chip near title.

5. In src/features/auth/OtpPage.tsx: Replace the verify() callback body with: setLoading(true); setTimeout(()=>{ setUser({id:'demo-001',businessName:'Demo Business',email:'demo@influnz.in',role:'business'} as any); navigate('/business',{replace:true}); setLoading(false); }, 800); — keep all OTP digit input logic and UI intact. Remove authService.verifyOtp and authService.resendOtp calls (keep imports).

6. In src/index.css (append at bottom): Add .in-demo-badge class — a small pill with coral gradient background, white text, lock icon prefix, 'Demo Mode' label. Sits above the form title. Also add .in-auth-form-card--enhanced upgrade: larger max-width 440px, stronger box shadow with --in-shadow-lg, 24px border-radius, white background with a 3px coral gradient top border accent. Add .in-auth-card-accent — a 3px top border gradient bar on the form card. These are purely additive; existing .in-auth-form-card continues to work.

All form validation still fires on blur (zod resolver unchanged)
